[[File:Phase_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|250px|[[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] passes through a wall to evade a [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra combat tri-droid]].]]
'''Phase''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that enabled the user to pass through solid matter, such as walls and doors. It could also be used to reach into someone’s body to deadly effect.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 3]]</ref>

==History==
[[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] was a known user of this ability. [[Bazel Warv]] could also use this ability when he was afflicted by his [[Force psychosis]]. After Bazel used it, [[Raynar Thul]] said that [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] developed the technique while they created the Maw. However, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] suggested that it was the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] that developed the ability since the Killiks absorbed the memories of any being who became [[Joiner|Joined]] to one of their nests.
